disease.name: Newcastle disease
disease.signs: Greenish diarrhoea, twisted neck, gasping, sudden drop in egg production
disease.actions: Isolate shed, stop movement, call vet, revaccinate healthy birds, disinfect

disease.name: Gumboro (Infectious bursal disease)
disease.signs: Ruffled feathers, whitish diarrhoea, vent pecking, 3-6 week chicks
disease.actions: Electrolytes + vitamins in water, reduce protein 2 days, call vet

disease.name: Coccidiosis
disease.signs: Bloody droppings, huddling, pale comb, poor growth
disease.actions: Anticoccidial in water (amprolium/toltrazuril), dry litter, call vet

disease.name: Chronic respiratory disease (Mycoplasma)
disease.signs: Sneezing, nasal discharge, swollen face, rales
disease.actions: Improve ventilation, tylosin/tiamulin as prescribed, check ammonia

disease.name: Colibacillosis (E. coli)
disease.signs: Omphalitis in chicks, airsacculitis, pericarditis on post-mortem
disease.actions: Water sanitation, antibiotic as per sensitivity, brooding hygiene

disease.name: Heat stress
disease.signs: Panting, wings spread, drop in feed intake, mortality in afternoons
disease.actions: Cool water with electrolytes, foggers, reduce stocking, feed at night

disease.name: Fowl pox
disease.signs: Scabs on comb/wattle, diphtheritic lesions in mouth
disease.actions: Vaccinate contact birds, iodine on lesions, mosquito control

disease.name: Marek’s disease
disease.signs: Leg paralysis (one forward one back), grey eye, tumours
disease.actions: Cull affected, check vaccination at hatchery, biosecurity
